sentences.text: JUDGMENT
The PSI of Sanjaynagara Police Station submitted charge sheet against the accused person for the offences punishable under sections 406 and 420 of IPC.
. The brief facts of the prosecution case is as follows:-

The case of the prosecution is that the CW-1 and CW-2 were residing at House No.13,
MS Ramaiah Road, Ashwathnagar, Puttaiah Compound, Bengaluru.
The accused is the relative of CW-1 and 2.
In the year 2015 the accused went to the CW-1 and CW-2 house approached financial assistance for his necessities and obtained hand loan amount of Rs.27,00,000/- on various dates.

The accused informed the CW-1 and CW-2 that he will sell his property situated at Sy.No.5/2, measuring 5 acres 13 guntas at Bugaduru Village, Pavagada Taluk, Nagalamadike Hobali, Tumkur District and executed an agreement and given on demand promissory note to them.

Thereafter,
the accused did not executed register the said property to them and sold the said property to one G.Sriramareddy on 21.02.2017 and thereby the accused person has committed the criminal breach of trust and cheated the complainant and committed the above offences.

After completion of the investigation the PSI of Sanjaynagara Police Station has filed the charge sheet against the accused person for the offences punishable under sections 406 and 420 of IPC.

In turn they have registered the case under Crime No.0209/2018.
Thereafter, police visited the spot, drew the mahazar, secured in the presence of the accused person subsequently the accused person enlarged on bail.

is dispensed with.

Heard the arguments from both side and perused the deposition and documents.
7. After hearing the parties and on perusal of records, the following points arose for my consideration.

1. Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that in the year 2015 the accused went to the CW-1 and CW-2 house approached financial assistance for his necessities and obtained hand loan amount of Rs.27,00,000/- on various dates.

My findings to the above points are as follows:
POINT No.1 : In the NEGATIVE.

REASONS 10. Point Nos.1 and 2: These above points are inter- linked with each others and required similar type of C.C.No.15266/2019 appreciation of evidence, Hence, they are taken together for common discussion.

11. In support of its case, the prosecution has examined one witness, the PW-1 is the complainant and got marked three documents i.e., Ex.P-1 is the Further Statement, Ex.P-2 is the Mahazar and Ex.P-3 is the statement of PW-2.

M.S.Ramaiah Road, Ashwathnagar, Puttaiah Compound, Bengaluru.
The accused is the relative of CW-1 and 2.
In the year 2015 the accused went to the CW-1 and CW-2 house approached financial assistance for his necessities and obtained hand loan amount of Rs.27,00,000/- on various dates.

The accused informed the CW-1 and CW-2 that he will sell his property situated at Sy.No.5/2,
measuring 5 acres 13 guntas at Bugaduru Village, Pavagada Taluk, Nagalamadike Hobali, Tumkur District and executed an agreement and given on demand promissory note to them.

Thereafter, the accused did not executed register the said property to them and sold the said property to one G.Sriramareddy on 21.02.2017 and thereby the accused person C.C.No.15266/2019 has committed the criminal breach of trust and cheated the complainant and committed the above offences.

After completion of the investigation the PSI of Sanjaynagara Police Station has filed the charge sheet against the accused person for the offences punishable under sections 406 and 420 of IPC.
13.
In the instant case the PW-1 and PW-2 have turned hostile to the prosecution case and not supported to the prosecution case.
During the course of cross examination by the learned Sr. APP nothing has been elicited from their mouth.
14. In this case, the prosecution has failed to elicit anything favorable to it to prove the allegations against the accused person under sections 406 and 420 of IPC.
When these being the facts, I am of the opinion that in total the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused person beyond all reasonable doubt.
In view of the same, this court hold Point Nos.1 and 2 in the Negative.
15. Point No.3:
For the reasons stated and finding given to point Nos.1 and 2, the following is made.

4 C.C.No.15266/2019 ORDER
The accused person is not found guilty for the offences punishable under section 406 and 420 of IPC.
Acting under section 248(1) of Code of Criminal Procedure the accused person is hereby acquitted for the offences punishable under section 406 and 420 of IPC.
The bail bond and surety bond executed by him stand canceled.
